basketballTransfer: Full fuel tanks mean your 10th sprint of the game looks like your first — and your jumper stays smooth late.
coachingPoints: Rice is a perfect basketball fuel — cheap, familiar, and effective

description: Why carbs are a basketball player's best friend: how they power sprints and jumps, when to load them around training, and the best Vietnamese carb sources.

howTo.detail: Rice, noodles, pho, bread, sweet potato, or oats — roughly half your plate on training days.
howTo.title: Make carbs the base of every meal

howTo.detail: Bigger carb portions at the meals before training; lighter ones after rest days.

howTo.detail: Plain rice beats an exotic superfood your stomach has never met.

title: Carbohydrates: Basketball Fuel
